desc: The Unity Tactical SPARK CAGE is a purpose-built mounting accessory that expands the versatility of the SPARK and SPARK IR marking lights. Molded from durable, impact-resistant polymer, the CAGE securely locks a single SPARK into place via a snug press-fit. Its four-sided design includes split pass-through channels for standard 1″ webbing, making it easy to weave into MOLLE or other load-bearing gear. For even greater flexibility, integral rare earth magnets allow the SPARK Cage to attach to most metal surfaces, giving users multiple mounting solutions for marking and identification in austere environments.
